lead_basis: Leads 1-2: all five primary metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1 >= 75%; AUC >= 0.75) pass pooled over the ENNS 2018, 2019 and 2021 walk-forward rounds (owner rule, 2026-11-13). From Lead 3 pooled precision (73.1%) and F1 (74.5%) fall below 75%. No lead passes in every single round (2018 precision 72.7%; 2021 recall 25%).

2026-Q4.note: This forecast used figures for periods ending before 1 November 2026 as published by 8 November 2026: October 2026 consumer prices (PSA CPI) and September 2026 unemployment (PSA LFS) were released after 1 November. Later forecasts use only figures published before their issue date. Removing these inputs entirely would move each province's forecast by at most about 2 points; every province stays Low risk.
